resultUnavailable: Result unavailable — only the winner can view this order.
paidNote: is paid. The seller will contact you for handover.
expiredNote: The 5:00 payment window for this order has passed.
relistNote: The seller can relist this item as a new auction item — watch the lobby for its return.
paymentNotFoundNote: This order does not exist or you are not its winner.
verifyEmail: Account created — check your email to verify it, then sign in.
emailNotConfirmed: This email isn't verified yet — check your inbox for the verification email.
resendSent: Verification email sent — check your inbox.
titleRequired: Give your stream a title (1–80 characters).
settleNote: Active item closes, winner locks, order created.
videoOnlyNote: Video/chat stop, auction runs until timer ends.
camBlocked: Camera or mic blocked — allow access and retry.
noDevice: No camera or mic found on this device.
camInUse: Camera or mic is in use by another app — close it and retry.
bidNotStarted: Waiting for the seller to start the bid.
softNote: Bids in the last seconds extend the clock.
hardNote: The clock never moves. Last bid wins.
pickCategory: Pick a category to open bidding.
footerNote: HOBYD pilot demo — sandbox payments, no real money.
